Metadata.title: Draft Analyst
Metadata.description: Account analysis, tournament draft simulator and draft review for League of Legends.

Footer.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Riot Games or OP.GG.

Home.title: Draft Analyst
Home.subtitle: Analyze your team's accounts, simulate tournament drafts against an AI coach and review match drafts.

Team.title: Team
Team.intro: Paste a multi OP.GG link, profile links or Riot IDs (one per line or comma separated) to analyze the team's accounts.
Team.dataNotice: Data comes from OP.GG and may be outdated if the profile has not been refreshed there for a while.
Team.tooMany: Found {count} players; only the first 5 were used.
Team.empty: No Riot ID found in the text.
Team.storageUnavailable: Could not save the team in this browser.
Team.requestFailed: Could not fetch the players right now. Try again.
Team.comfortHelp: Combines games played, win rate adjusted for small samples and how recently the champion was played.
